name: The Entropic Cascade
description: Entropy dominates. Dissolve the old and remake the world.

stages.description: Entropy reaches 30% influence in at least 2 regions.

conditions.description: Entropy sphere influence at 0.3+ in 2+ regions

stages.description: Entropy reaches 40% influence in at least 4 regions.

conditions.description: Entropy sphere influence at 0.4+ in 4+ regions

stages.description: Entropy reaches 50% influence in at least 5 regions. Dissolution is complete.

conditions.description: Entropy sphere influence at 0.5+ in 5+ regions

prose.setup_to_escalation: Two regions begin to fracture. Order unravels at its seams. The old structures feel the weight of dissolution. Change is coming.
prose.escalation_to_culmination: Four territories crumble and transform. The cascade of entropy spreads—old kingdoms dissolve into possibility. Renewal rises from the ashes of decay.
prose.completed: Five realms have been unmade and remade in your image. The Cascade is complete. What was is no longer. Entropy has baptized the world.
prose.failed: The decay halts. Remnants of the old order reassert themselves. Your dissolution was incomplete. Order reassumes its throne.
